name: Minefield
author: Mark Steere (2024) / AGP port
description: Square-board connection game (Mark Steere, 2024) in which a filled board always has a winner. Black joins the top and bottom edges, White the left and right, with ORTHOGONAL chains only. Every point is a mine: you may never form a 'hard corner' (three stones in a 2x2 whose diagonal pair matches) or a 'switch' (four stones on the corners of an otherwise empty 2x3 or 2x4 area, one colour on each diagonal) — in any reflection, rotation or colour reversal. Pie rule.
